# Dating Method

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:DatingMethod`](gmeow-DatingMethod.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/DatingMethod>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The method used to derive a temporal measurement — radiocarbon, dendrochronology, thermoluminescence, etc. A value, never a subclass. Specialises [`gmeow:ObservationMethod`](gmeow-ObservationMethod.md) for the temporal dating domain.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:ObservationMethod`](gmeow-ObservationMethod.md), [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:DatingMethod`](gmeow-DatingMethod.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:ObservationMethod`](gmeow-ObservationMethod.md), [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the value vocabulary for how a temporal measurement was derived — radiocarbon, dendrochronology, U-Pb, stratigraphic correlation — referenced via [`gmeow:measurementMethod`](../properties/gmeow-measurementMethod.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid modelling a dating technique as a subclass (methods are individuals) and avoid using it for non-dating observation methods; it specializes [`gmeow:ObservationMethod`](gmeow-ObservationMethod.md) for the temporal domain only.

### How to use

- Reference a seeded [`gmeow:DatingMethod`](gmeow-DatingMethod.md) individual from a measurement via [`gmeow:measurementMethod`](../properties/gmeow-measurementMethod.md); mint a new individual rather than a subclass when a technique is missing.

### Examples

- ex:myMethod a [`gmeow:DatingMethod`](gmeow-DatingMethod.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "varve chronology"@en.
